text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Avulsion Fracture of the Extensor Tendon at the DIP).

The history of a forced flexion injury, combined with the inability to actively extend the distal interphalangeal joint and the finger resting in flexion, is classic for this condition. Please request an X-Ray of the right hand to rule out an avulsion fracture. REQUEST IMAGES: Right_Hand_XRay

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
